Hierarchy 1 description en: The site/feature has been identified in the field, either through primary fieldwork and/or recorded in published data and can be clearly seen and identified on the imagery OR exact co-ordinates have been provided/published (and you have no reason to doubt their accuracy), even if the site cannot be seen on the imagery. Location in Decimal Degrees (or converted to such from Degrees, Minutes, Seconds)
Hierarchy 1 description alternative en: The extent of site/feature has been mapped in the field (either primary or secondary sources)

Hierarchy 1 description en: The site/feature has been identified in legacy data in Decimal Degrees (or converted to such from Degrees, Minutes, Seconds) and/or can be clearly confirmed from imagery (preferably multiple images and no issues with 'shifting location'). Its location may confirmed by historic map data.
Hierarchy 1 description alternative en: The extent of site/feature has been mapped in the field however there may be some concern over the correspondence between the field and imagery extents OR The site/feature has a very clear boundary and is very similar on multiple images. The site, however, may not have been mapped in the field

Hierarchy 1 description en: The site/Feature has been identified on map in legacy document and/or historic map. It is also identifiable on imagery, although there may be some concern over its 'shifting location' in different imagery sets. This may be due to poor imagery, rectification issues and/or limited data. Location coordinates in Degrees, Minutes, Seconds or Decimal Degrees.
Hierarchy 1 description alternative en: The site/feature appears to have a fairly clear boundary and it is similar on multiple images. References to the site extent within published data may roughly correspond to what is identifiable via imagery.

Hierarchy 1 description en: The site/feature is possibly identifiable on imagery or historic maps or you have an approximate location (e.g. to within less than a kilometer) from sketch maps or descriptions, however, there is concern over the precision of the location due to poor imagery, rectification issues and/or limited data. Also use this category If coordinates are recorded in legacy data but given in only Degrees and Minutes with no seconds.
Hierarchy 1 description alternative en: The site/feature has a diffuse boundary (i.e. it is hard to identify from imagery where the site starts and ends). It appears to have a different extent on different images. Alternatively, if the extent of site is listed by published sources it is only referred to using very broad size categories e.g. 0-5ha.

Hierarchy 1 description en: Site/Feature is recorded in publication and/or identified from historic maps but have not checked/confirmed by remote sensing or ground verification
Hierarchy 1 description alternative en: The site's extent has not been verified by the operator entering the data and/or any other source of information
The site is only represented by a point and no reference to its precise or approximate size is made in legacy data or indicated in any illustrations or maps or is visible on satellite imagery
